messages:
ellen: Starting a focused follow-up for last-night's TLS fallback + retry amplification. I'll list action items and tentative owners; shout if you want to take anything.
noah: Root cause summary: routing selector sent some traffic cross-region on transient cert timeouts. Clients retried which hit capacity on other region LBs and DNS edges with inconsistent TTLs.
tanya: I'll take the runtime mitigation: implement a short-lived per-request retry cap (2 retries) and expose a feature flag for rollout. ETA 2026-03-29.
ben: I'll take the routing service patch to prefer regional affinity unless explicit health signal says otherwise. Will add unit tests and e2e. ETA 2026-04-07.
elllen: (typo) ellen: @tanya @ben coordinate on how the retry cap interacts with affinity logic in the router.
tanya: Plan: feature flag -> 10% canary -> 50% -> full. Add a smoke test that simulates cert timeouts. I'll post the test script here.
ops-bot: Alert snapshot: dns_edge_ttl_variance detected; sample log:
"2026-03-22T04:02:11Z WARN DNS edge=eu-west observed_TTL=1s expected=300s zone=api.redwood.ai"
ashley: I'll own the DNS follow-up: run registrar audit and edge cache invalidation across regions. I'll aim to complete by 2026-03-26.
noah: Also need monitoring + runbook: add a metric tls_handshake.timeout_rate and a dashboard tile. Owner: ellen, ETA 2026-03-28.
elllen: I'll draft the runbook and include exact pager steps (who to call at registrar, edge infra). ETA as above.
ben: For rollout safety, we should wire an automatic rollback if tls_handshake.timeout_rate spikes after change. I'll add a rollback hook to the deployment pipeline. ETA 2026-04-02.
tanya: Will add a synthetic that does dig+curl to compare authoritative cert chain and TTL every 5m; if mismatch >30s, send low-priority page. ETA 2026-03-27.
ellen: Long-term: add a weekly "networking anomalies" spike report so recurring patterns (retries/TLS timeouts) are trended. Owner: noah, start 2026-04-01.
noah: I'll create a short template and post in #eng-sre.
ops-bot: Created task: INC-7942; linked to postmortem.
elllen: Summary of owners + targets:
- tanya: runtime retry cap + synthetic probe (2026-03-29 / 2026-03-27)
- ben: routing affinity fix + rollback hook (2026-04-07 / 2026-04-02)
- ashley: DNS registrar audit + edge cache flush (2026-03-26)
- ellen: monitoring + runbook (2026-03-28)
- noah: weekly networking anomalies report (start 2026-04-01)
Please react with :white_check_mark: or reassign.
ashley: :white_check_mark: assigned and filing registrar ticket now.
ben: noted, filing RFC and PR branch.
tanya: PR will be up later today.
elllen: Thanks everyone, I'll add these to the postmortem doc and close INC-7942 when tasks are done.
